title: Kimi K3 P40 Vulkan preflight
scope: isolated tiny-checkpoint engine and backend validation only

vulkan_tiny_oracle.result: same tiny oracle and checkpoint checks passed

tiny_manual_decode.meaning: toy fixture only; not applicable to full Kimi K3

full_model.blocker: The original Kimi K3 source checkpoint is approximately 1.56 TB, while the available AI SSD capacity is approximately 178 GiB.

architecture_finding.path: Kimi K3 uses Colibri Vulkan, not the Qwen CUDA tier.
architecture_finding.active_device: The tiny Vulkan run selected physical GPU 0.
architecture_finding.multi_gpu: The generic backend has a second-device primitive, but the inspected Kimi K3 engine does not wire it.

decision: Do not download, install, enable, or claim a Kimi K3 service or speed result until a dedicated fast volume with at least 2 TB usable capacity is attached and the complete checkpoint is present.
